title: Taiwan MND: 3 PLA Aircraft, 6 PLAN Ships Detected; One Sortie Enters Southwest ADIZ
detail: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported 3 sorties of PLA aircraft, 6 PLAN vessels and 4 official ships around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. (UTC+8) on September 29. One of the three sorties entered the southwestern ADIZ.

media.caption: Taiwan reports 3 PLA aircraft, 6 PLAN vessels operating near island
